REBC.description: Rebar Input for Column Section (REBC). The endpoint key is the section id (sectK); each request carries an ITEMS array where each item is one rebar arrangement for that column section (a main-section item, or a sub-section item when CREATE_SUB_SECTION=true).

ITEMS.description: List of concrete-column rebar items for this section. Each entry defines main bars, end/center shear bars, and optional sub-section element targeting.

items.description: One column-section rebar entry. When CREATE_SUB_SECTION=true the ELEMS block selects the elements the sub-section applies to; otherwise the entry updates the section's main rebar arrangement.

CREATE_SUB_SECTION.description: If true, create/target a sub-section for a specific set of elements; requires ELEMS. If false or omitted the item edits the section-level rebar.

ID.description: Sub-section id (subSectK). Omit to auto-generate the next free id when CREATE_SUB_SECTION=true; provide to target/overwrite a specific existing sub-section. 0/absent means the section-level record.

ELEMS.description: Element selection for the sub-section. Provide exactly one of KEYS, TO, or STRUCTURE_GROUP_NAME. Selected elements must belong to this section (element.elpro == sectK) or the request is rejected. Required when CREATE_SUB_SECTION=true.

KEYS.description: Explicit element ids to include in the sub-section.

TO.description: Element id range expression (e.g. "1to10" / "1 3 5to9") resolved to element ids.

STRUCTURE_GROUP_NAME.description: Name of a structure group; its member elements are used.

MAIN_BAR.description: Column main (longitudinal) rebar arrangement. Corner rebar (NAME_CORNER) is optional and only accepted for SB (solid rectangle) shaped sections when USE_CORNER=true.

NAME.description: Main rebar size/name, validated against the rebar material DB. Typical values: D4, D5, D6, D7, D8, D10, D13, D16, D19, D22, D25, D29, D32, D35, D38, D41, D43, D51, D57.

USE_CORNER.description: Whether corner rebar is used. Only valid for SB (solid rectangle) sections; if true, NAME_CORNER is required.

NAME_CORNER.description: Corner rebar size/name (same rebar DB set as NAME). Required when USE_CORNER=true; rejected on non-SB shapes.

SHEAR_BAR_END.description: Shear (hoop) rebar at the member ends (I & J).

NAME.description: Hoop rebar size/name, validated against the rebar material DB (same set as MAIN_BAR.NAME).

LEG_Y.description: Number of legs in local Y direction (must be > 0).

LEG_Z.description: Number of legs in local Z direction (must be > 0).

DIST.description: Spacing/distance between hoop rebars (length unit; unit-aware).

SHEAR_BAR_CEN.description: Shear (hoop) rebar at the member center (M). Same structure as SHEAR_BAR_END; when END and CEN match, the model records them as synced.

NAME.description: Hoop rebar size/name, validated against the rebar material DB (same set as MAIN_BAR.NAME).

LEG_Y.description: Number of legs in local Y direction (must be > 0).

LEG_Z.description: Number of legs in local Z direction (must be > 0).

DIST.description: Spacing/distance between hoop rebars (length unit; unit-aware).

DO.description: Distance from concrete face to the center of the rebar (do) (length unit; unit-aware).

HOOP_TYPE.description: Type of hoop rebar (case-insensitive). "Ties" (DB index 1) or "Spirals" (DB index 2).

HOOK_TYPE.description: Hook type code: 0 = 90-degree hook (H90), 1 = both ends. Any other value is rejected.
